rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for carbon dioxide gas.

example.english: Plants need to absorb carbon dioxide from the air before they can photosynthesize.
example.traditional: 啲植物要吸收空氣入面嘅二氧化碳，先可以進行光合作用。
